system.description:
Fake a step, a stumble, an opening that isn't there. Once per round, in place of one attack, make a Charisma (Deception) or Dexterity check against the target's Wisdom check. Sell it, and they overcommit to defending against a strike that was never coming. On a success, choose one: the target has Disadvantage on its next attack against you, or you have Advantage on your next attack against it.

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.
